other_conditions: Full-time regular/permanent faculty members of AICTE‑approved Polytechnic (Diploma) institutes with at least one year of teaching experience and a bachelor's degree for Master's programs.
Full-time regular/permanent faculty members of AICTE‑approved Degree Level institutes with at least three years of teaching experience and a master's degree for Ph.D. programs.
Applicants must have a valid AICTE Faculty ID.
Eligibility criteria of the respective QIP centre must be fulfilled.
All eligibility is assessed as of the last date of application submission.
benefits_summary: Scholarships of ₹9,000 per month for ME/M.Tech and ₹15,000 per month for Ph.D., along with annual contingency and pre‑Ph.D. allowances.
